# `FluxSubmitOverlayFrameFn`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">callback</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Callback used by plugins to submit one complete RGBA8 overlay frame.

## Signature

```rust
pub type FluxSubmitOverlayFrameFn = unsafe extern "C" fn (context : * mut c_void , width : u32 , height : u32 , rgba8 : * const u8 , len : usize ,) -> FluxStatus;
```

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxsubmitoverlayframefn.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxsubmitoverlayframefn.md)_

```rust
unsafe fn submit_checkerboard(
    callback: FluxSubmitOverlayFrameFn,
    context: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
) -> FluxStatus {
    let rgba8 = [
        255, 0, 0, 255, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        0, 0, 0, 0, 255, 0, 0, 255,
    ];
    unsafe { callback(context, 2, 2, rgba8.as_ptr(), rgba8.len()) }
}
```
